text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No antidote for MULPLETA overdose is known. In the event of overdose, platelet count may increase excessively and result in thrombotic or thromboembolic complications. Closely monitor the patient and platelet count. Treat thrombotic complications in accordance with standard of care. Hemodialysis is not expected to enhance the elimination of MULPLETA because lusutrombopag is highly bound to protein in plasma [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) ] .
